review.why: Generates API reference docs from code: endpoints, errors and examples in several languages, with a document outline.
review.summary: Describes how to document an API from its code: endpoint details, request and response specs, cURL, JavaScript and Python examples, usage guides, error handling and interactive formats. It gives full worked examples for a REST endpoint, a GraphQL query and authentication, a nine-section outline and a pitfalls list.
strengths: Complete worked examples for REST, GraphQL and authentication
Document outline from introduction to changelog
Pitfalls list: drift, missing errors, broken examples
cautions: Written as 'I'll examine your code' but gives no concrete method to read a codebase
Points to related skills that are not included
